answer: One defence is Proof of unique stock photo sale record: photos licensed to buyers over five years, and the zenith of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while photos licensed to buyers over five years takes days to arrange for each new name; the island is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the mesa of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
